items.name: Paintless dent repair (hood, roof, trunk lid)
items.description: PDR technician removes hail dents without repainting. Factory paint stays intact.
items.reason: Removes the hail disclosure entirely, so buyers bid it as a clean car.

items.name: Detail and light paint correction
items.description: One-step polish to remove swirl marks after PDR, plus interior detail.
items.reason: Finishes the PDR work so the panels look uniform in photos.

items.name: Replace and repaint hood
items.description: New hood panel, painted and blended to match.
items.reason: PDR fixes the hood for less, and a repaint shows up on paint-meter readings.

items.name: Ceramic coating
items.reason: Buyers don't pay extra for coatings on a used sedan.

scenarios.explanation: With the hail removed, this sells as a clean-title, clean-body Accord. The jump in bids is far bigger than the repair bill, and arbitration risk drops too.
Salvage buyers expect to do repairs themselves, so they won't pay you back for dent work. Sell as-is if you sell here.
